paragraphs.label: Mở thư và nhận lời
paragraphs.text:
Dear Ms Brown,

Thank you for your invitation to a neighbourhood walking event. I am pleased to accept and would welcome the opportunity to take part. I appreciate the time you have spent making the arrangements.

paragraphs.template:
Dear [danh xưng và họ người nhận],

Thank you for your invitation to [sự kiện / hoạt động]. I am pleased to accept and would welcome the opportunity to take part. I appreciate the time you have spent making the arrangements.

paragraphs.label: Xác nhận sắp xếp
paragraphs.text: I understand that the event will take place at the park entrance on Saturday at nine in the morning. I will plan my journey accordingly. Please let me know if there are any changes to the time or location.

paragraphs.label: Chuẩn bị và hỗ trợ
paragraphs.text: I am particularly interested in the opportunity to explore a short local route and note useful improvements. I would also be happy to assist with the preparations if needed.
